desc: The X-Bolt 2 Mountain hunting rifle features a carbon fiber stock with a compression molded carbon fiber bedding block and accent graphics; Cerakote Tungsten finish on a lightweight carbon fiber wrapped stainless steel barrel with a threaded muzzle; redesigned receiver and bolt; stainless steel receiver w/X-Lock scope mounting system and easy to reach top tang safety. Includes Recoil Hawg muzzle brake and thread protector.
